name: BLAST
author: 100demons
summary: Fourteen tonal OPL2 two-operator FM models, with a stepped modulator ratio on SWEEP.

knobs.does: Index: the FM modulation index / modulator level, the mallet hardness or the feedback
Model: SIN, HLF, ABS, PLS, BAS, PIA, MAR, GLK, BRS, ACC, STR, STL, TMP, ZAP
Ratio: the modulator ratio in three-character steps (1:2 … 15X); FUNC leaves the steps
Env: how the sound moves (brightness decay, swell, feedback, detune, mallet click)

cpu_note: About 60 to 84 % of a stock TONE voice per block (source-tree measurement); a silent voice costs almost nothing.
emulator_proof: source-tree proofs: all 14 models, GATE on/off, silence, cost, memory, stack; OS proof with boot, descriptors, names and ratios

credits.what: the engine code, tables and design
